text: Nearby startable activities show glowing beacons, and the active activity's targets get 3D rings or markers plus a guide arrow.
Finishing or failing a minigame shows a results card with time, medal and best, and Retry restarts it.
Every timed minigame has ordered gold, silver and bronze thresholds inside its time limit, and the best medal is kept.
The photo album keeps at most 30 compact JPEG photos that survive a reload.
No ring, landing pad, pickup, drop-off, collectible or hover spot sits inside a building; boats stay on water.
At least 30 ring courses, 25 photo challenges, 20 deliveries, 15 landings, 15 collects, 10 follows, 10 chases and 8 hovers, each with sources.
